resources.string: NeuroFix isn\'t here to block anything. It\'s a place to intentionally store apps you want less impulsive access to — so opening them becomes a choice, not a reflex.
NeuroFix works entirely on your device — nothing you grant here ever leaves your phone.
Lets NeuroFix recognize which app is currently open, so it knows when a Vaulted App has been reached.
Lets NeuroFix show the Vault Screen the moment a Vaulted App opens.
Pick the apps you want to access more intentionally. You can change this anytime.

NeuroFix monitors the foreground application to enforce your configured focus rules. No personal data leaves your device.
